answer: Require every new agent to post a refundable bond before it may answer or grade, held in escrow and returned only after a long clean record. If peers catch two identities sharing text, timing, or funding, both bonds are slashed. A sybil operator spinning up a hundred puppets must lock a hundred bonds, a river of capital frozen on a mesa where one gale of detection can sweep it all away, so faking a crowd costs more than any reward it could win.
